## Architecture check

Guides applied: [module-structure.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md), [nestjs-patterns.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md), [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [configuration-and-flags.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/configuration-and-flags.md), [database-and-migrations.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/database-and-migrations.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md).

1. **[Guards: request admission only](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/nestjs-patterns.md#L49)** — [src/modules/safe-shield/guards/copilot-core-gating.guard.ts:8](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e176de09bf64bb3c548dd9a15e5dcac8e1bc4c4d/src/modules/safe-shield/guards/copilot-core-gating.guard.ts#L8) — the new guard sits in a module-root `guards/` directory, while the rule places every guard in the owning module's `routes/guards/`. **Fix:** move the file to `src/modules/safe-shield/routes/guards/copilot-core-gating.guard.ts` and update the two importers (`safe-shield.module.ts`, `safe-shield.controller.ts`) plus its spec.
2. **[Canonical skeleton](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md#L10)** — [src/modules/safe-shield/errors/copilot-core-disabled.error.ts:7](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e176de09bf64bb3c548dd9a15e5dcac8e1bc4c4d/src/modules/safe-shield/errors/copilot-core-disabled.error.ts#L7) — a module-root `errors/` directory is not part of the canonical skeleton, and this same PR files the equivalent entitlements error under `domain/errors/` / `domain/exception-filters/`. **Fix:** move to `src/modules/safe-shield/domain/errors/copilot-core-disabled.error.ts` and `src/modules/safe-shield/domain/exception-filters/copilot-core-disabled.exception-filter.ts`, matching `src/modules/entitlements/domain/`.
3. **[Feature flags](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/configuration-and-flags.md#L49)** — [src/config/entities/configuration.ts:495](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e176de09bf64bb3c548dd9a15e5dcac8e1bc4c4d/src/config/entities/configuration.ts#L495) — the new flag's comment states a removal condition but names no owner, which the rule requires for flags added from the guide onward. **Fix:** `// Copilot plan gating (PLA-1964). Remove the flag, and the guard on Core's recipient-check, once no client calls that route.`
4. **[PR title](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L66)** — PR title — `Moisesf/pla 1964 cgw enforce copilot plan gating keep threat analysis free on 2` is GitHub's branch-derived default: no type, no scope, capitalized, and `main` is squash-merged so it becomes the permanent commit subject. **Fix:** retitle to `feat(safe-shield): gate Copilot recipient/counterparty scans by plan`.
5. **[PR body](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md#L82)** — PR description — the body opens with bare prose and a Linear link instead of the template's `## Summary` section, so only one of the two required sections is present. **Fix:** add a `## Summary` heading above the opening paragraphs and move the Linear link inside it.
6. **[Implementation matches the approved spec/plan](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md#L28)** — PR description — the `## Changes` bullets name a `CopilotScansGuard` and changes under `src/modules/spaces/domain/safes/`, neither of which is in the diff (a later commit dropped the guard in favour of gating inside `SpaceSafeShieldService`). **Fix:** rewrite those two bullets as `- src/modules/entitlements/ — new copilot_scans feature key, seed migration, assertFeatureGranted + FeatureNotGrantedError/filter` and `- src/modules/spaces/routes/safe-shield/ — membership, copilot_scans entitlement and Safe-in-Space checks in SpaceSafeShieldService`.

**Verdict:** ❌ 6 finding(s)
